descriptionChirho: Dodo, a Hebrew proper name borne by at least two individuals: the grandfather of the judge Tola (Judg 10:1) and the father of Eleazar one of David's mighty men (2 Sam 23:9, 1 Chr 11:12). English 'Dodo/[k]', Spanish 'Dodo/Dodó/[Dodi]', Hindi दोदो, Arabic دُودُو, Korean 도도/[도드], Swahili 'Dodo'. The ketiv variant [k] represents an orthographic alternation of the same personal name, not a distinct individual.
